Auto link conversion with accessible names disabled

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		InlineDataMedia: ptr(htmd.InlineDataMediaAltTextOnly),
		TierStrategy:    ptr(htmd.TierStrategy(`Auto`)),
	}
	result, err := htmd.ConvertWithAccessibleNames(`<p>see <a href="https://example.com/x">GitHub<svg aria-label="(opens in new tab)"><use href="#ext"></use></svg></a> now</p>`, false, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
